title: Waqt bura ho, Mahakal saath hain
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Waqt bura ho, Mahakal saath hain

scenes.prompt: Close-up darshan of the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga of Ujjain: a dark polished black stone Shivling with a silver naag hood and silver arch above it, white and orange marigold garlands, bel leaves, a silver trishul beside it, in a dark quiet sanctum lit only by small brass diyas, deep shadows, warm golden glow, the Shivling in the middle of the frame, no people
scenes.tts: जब वक़्त बुरा हो… तब भी महाकाल साथ होते हैं।
scenes.sub: Jab waqt bura ho… tab bhi Mahakal saath hote hain.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the Shivling stays still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly, the golden glow gently pulses

scenes.prompt: Darshan of the black stone Mahakaleshwar Shivling, slightly wider view in a dark sanctum, silver naag hood, many glowing brass diyas in front, white flowers and bel leaves, warm golden light, no people
scenes.tts: महाकालेश्वर, उज्जैन। बारह ज्योतिर्लिंगों में से एक।
scenes.sub: Mahakaleshwar, Ujjain. Barah Jyotirlingon mein se ek.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the Shivling stays still, many diya flames flicker softly, a few flower petals drift in the background

scenes.prompt: A single brass diya flame glowing in a dark quiet temple sanctum, soft golden light on old stone, white flowers and bel leaves beside it, warm shadows, calm and hopeful mood, no people
scenes.tts: मान्यता है, यह दक्षिणमुखी है। मन भारी हो, तो नाम लो।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai, yeh dakshinamukhi hai. Man bhaari ho, to naam lo.
scenes.animate: the diya flame flickers softly, a thin wisp of incense smoke rises slowly, flower petals rest still

scenes.tts: हर हर महादेव! अच्छा लगे तो लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें। जय महाकाल!
scenes.sub: Har Har Mahadev! Achha lage to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein. Jai Mahakal!
